fullDescription: A modern minimalist mobile interface designed for service-oriented applications like lost and found, community tools, or local marketplaces. The design features a high-contrast white aesthetic with vibrant gradient action cards (sky blue and orange), editorial typography using General Sans and Satoshi, and a clean bottom navigation bar. It utilizes large border-radii (32px), subtle shadows, and micro-interactions for a premium, app-like feel on the web. Keywords: mobile-first, minimalist, glassmorphism accents, gradient cards, editorial typography, service UI, clean design, view-transitions.

structured.summary: A clean, high-contrast mobile UI with a focus on editorial typography and bold action cards. It uses a strictly white background with slate-toned text and vibrant gradients to guide user attention.

style.description: The style is characterized by sophisticated typography pairing (General Sans for headings, Satoshi for body), a clean white palette (#FFFFFF) accented by Slate-900 for high-contrast elements, and vibrant gradients for primary CTAs. It uses generous corner radii (32px for cards, 12px for icons) and ultra-subtle shadows for depth without clutter.
style.prompt: Create a design using a white (#FFFFFF) background with text in Slate-900 (#0F172A) and Slate-500 (#64748B). Typography: Headings in 'General Sans' (weights: 600, 500) with tight tracking and 1.1 line-height; Body text in 'Satoshi' (weights: 500, 400). Color Palette: Lost-Action Gradient (linear-gradient(135deg, #0EA5E9 0%, #0284C7 100%)), Found-Action Gradient (linear-gradient(135deg, #FB923C 0%, #F97316 100%)), Borders in Slate-100 (#F1F5F9). Shadow: 0 4px 20px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04). Use transition-all 0.25s for interactions and active:scale-95 micro-interactions on clickable elements.

layout_and_structure.description: A vertical stack optimized for mobile viewports, including a fixed header, a scrollable main content area containing a hero section, primary action cards, and a horizontal-scrolling recent activity list, finished with a persistent bottom navigation bar.

prompts.prompt: Design a header with pt-14 px-8 pb-6. Left side: Logo composed of a 36x36px Slate-900 rounded-xl box containing a white icon and the brand name 'FindIt' in 20px General Sans Semibold. Right side: A 40x40px rounded-full profile button with a Slate-50 background, Slate-100 border, and a Slate-600 user icon. Include active:scale-95 on the profile button.

A typography-driven section at the top of the main content. Headline (H1) should be 36px, leading-1.1, General Sans Semibold, Slate-900, with tight tracking. Below it, a paragraph in Satoshi 17px, Slate-500, max-width 280px, leading-relaxed, describing the service.

Two large vertical blocks stacked with 20px spacing. Each card should have p-6, rounded-[32px], and a gradient background. Inside: A left-aligned stack with a label (white/80, 14px Medium) and a title (white, 24px General Sans Semibold). On the right: A 48x48px container with bg-white/10, backdrop-blur-md, and rounded-2xl containing a white icon. Apply a minimal shadow (rgba(0,0,0,0.04)) and active:scale-[0.98] interaction.

A horizontal-scrolling section. Header: 'Recently reported' in 18px General Sans Semibold with a 'View all' link in Sky-600. List items: Cards with 140px min-width, Slate-50 background, Slate-100 border, rounded-2xl. Each card contains a white 1:1 aspect-ratio icon container, a 14px bold title, and 11px meta-text in Slate-500.

A fixed bottom bar with backdrop-blur (nav-blur, white 98% opacity) and a top border of Slate-100. Height includes pb-34px (safe area). Items: Four evenly spaced vertical stacks. Active item: Slate-900 icon and 10px bold uppercase text. Inactive items: Slate-400 icon and text. Use tracking-wider for navigation labels.

special_ui_components.description: Small icons inside action cards that use background blur for a premium look.
special_ui_components.prompt: Create a 48x48px container. Background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Backdrop-filter: blur(12px). Border-radius: 16px. Centered icon: white, 24px size.

special_ui_components.description: High-impact navigational cards with specific color ramps.
special_ui_components.prompt: Rectangular container with 32px border radius. Gradient lost: from #0EA5E9 to #0284C7. Gradient found: from #FB923C to #F97316. Padding: 24px. Layout: Flexbox justify-between items-center. Use white text with 80% opacity for secondary labels and 100% for titles.

structured.special_notes: MUST use 'General Sans' for brand and primary headings to maintain the editorial feel. MUST use 'Satoshi' for body copy for legibility. DO NOT use heavy shadows; the shadow-to-border ratio should favor thin borders and very faint shadows (4% opacity). DO NOT use sharp corners; use minimum 12px for small items and 32px for large containers. Ensure 'view-transition' properties are applied for smooth navigation between states.
